annotations.text:
FITS contact-QR app — one screen, three cards on a circular swipe (swiping past the third wraps back to the first).
Every QR is real and scannable: a vCard 3.0 with name, role, FITS org, email, phone, the Roskilde address and https://fits.dk.
All three pages share the Card component on the right, so an edit there hits every page.
